violated_contract: An index computed on a normalized copy of a string (lowercased, stripped) must not be applied to the original text: every transformation that changes offsets (leading/trailing strip, case-folding length changes) shifts the cut, so the extracted value silently starts mid-trigger. omi-twitter-app's extract_tweet_content located the trigger in text.lower().strip() but sliced the original, turning '  Tweet now hello' into 'ow hello' (issue #14351); the webhook's ' '.join(segment_texts) makes a leading-space or empty first segment reachable in production.
canonical_prevention: Anchor the slice in the original text with a case-insensitive search of the located phrase (re.search(re.escape(phrase), text, re.IGNORECASE)) and cut after the match; a manifest-registered hermetic suite pins extraction for leading whitespace, tabs, case differences, end-phrase stripping, and the no-trigger contract.
